title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) Transport Corridor 1 (Zhambyl Oblast Section) Investment Program - Tranche 3

description.narrative: Project 3 constructed 117.7-km road sections in total. ADB financed the (i) construction of a new 80-km Otar-Blagoveshchenka road section (Km 162-260); and (ii) rehabilitation of 10.3-km existing asphalt concrete road, and construction of a new 7.4-km asphalt concrete bypass approach road to the Kyrgyz border. JICA jointly cofinanced the construction of 20-km Kulan bypass road section (km 383-404).

title.narrative: Final results are in the Project/Program Completion Reports | Aug 2017: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/41121/41121-023-pcr-en.pdf
Loan 2697: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
Loan 8251: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
Progress Toward Outcome: The completed three road sections increased average traffic volume, reduced average travel time, reduced vehicle operating costs, and reduced the road crash rate.
Some results are in the Environmental Impact Assessments | Oct 2010: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//41121-043-eia-05.pdf
Some results are in the Project Performance Evaluation Reports | Oct 2020: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/evaluation-document/644231/files/in334-20_6.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Jul 2014: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//41121-043-rp-03.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Dec 2014: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//41121-043-smr-05.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: The construction at Kulan Bypass (Km 383-404) was completed in 2013 and defects were rectified by the end of the defects notification period in November 2015. The construction at Otar-Blagoveschenka road sections (Km 162-260) and Korday-KGZ border road section (Km 0- 17.7) were substantially completed in November 2014. Defects are currently being rectified until the end of the defects notification period in November 2016. All road sections were open to traffic after substantial completion.
